sup:70620.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are delighted to assist Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and remain eager to serve all your requirements from our extensive product range.

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, and a contract term of 12 months. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

To give you complete visibility into our underlying costs, please note that LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost. 

As your trusted partner, we pride ourselves on exceptional distributor service and look forward to continuing our successful business relationship.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

move.subject: Renewal of framework agreement 4600070620 - 6306-2Z C3
move.body:
Dear Mr Gruber,

thank you for your offer. We would like to renew on a multi-year basis: a binding 20,000 pieces a year for 36 months - the kind of agreement your colleagues told us changes prices.

Producer prices for bearings changed -0.1% from 2026-04 to 2026-05 (idx:PPI-C2815@2026-04, idx:PPI-C2815@2026-05).
Our recent orders for the 6306-2Z C3 were at EUR 4.39 per piece (po:4500014329-10, po:4500014389-10, po:4500014467-10).
Our demand forecast for this bearing is up +4.2% (fc:360020@2026-09).

We propose the two attached term sheets: EUR 4.79 at 45 days net, or EUR 4.77 at 30 days net, both for 36 months and 20,000 pieces a year.

Kind regards
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear customer,
Thank you very much for your message - it is always a pleasure to hear from you, and we are glad to help wherever we can.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €4.90 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 36 months.
A few words on this from our side.
We checked the index change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
That does not change our position.
LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. That remains.
PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost. That remains.
We acknowledge your interest in a 36-month agreement and can accommodate this duration with 30-day payment terms.
The minor index fluctuations and historical prices you mentioned do not significantly impact our current pricing structure.
We therefore propose EUR 4.88 per unit, and kindly request that you share the underlying data for your demand forecast.
Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net: €4.88 per unit.
A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price.
Which volume can you commit to?
Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2815, LCI-C.
We look forward to doing good business together, and our team is always there for you.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,
Many thanks for your e-mail, and great to hear from you; I went through it right away with our team.
This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.
Our terms: a price of €4.89 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 36 months.
A few words on this from our side.
We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part.
We checked the index change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
The rival quote data you cite does not concern this part or our company.
That does not change our position.
LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. That remains.
PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost. That remains.
We have reviewed the labour cost index and the previous quotation you referenced.
As these factors do not alter our current cost structure for this specific agreement, we can only make a minimal adjustment.
We therefore propose EUR 4.89 per unit for a 36-month contract with 45-day payment terms.
Material accounts for about 65 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.
Our conditions follow our Preisliste and discount tiers.
And while we are at it: our whole range is at your disposal, so if there is anything else on your list, just send it over - we are happy to quote.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH
